title: Trump policy that suspended visas for 75 countries struck down
script: This is World Pulse Daily with a quick news update. The story centers on this: Trump policy that suspended visas for 75 countries struck down. In simple words, A U.S. district judge said the policy "is contrary to law and was issued in excess of Secretary Rubio's statutory authority." Some details may change as more information becomes available, so viewers should check trusted news sources for the newest update. We will continue watching for clearer and more reliable updates.
